name: AUTO-S + LR-Adaptive Noise (LR-ANS)
tagline: Per-sample normalize gradients (AUTO-S, γ=0.01) and scale noise as 1/sqrt(lr_t) of the cosine LR; sigma_0 calibrated so harmonic-mean = budget sigma.

key_hyperparams.name: lr_floor
key_hyperparams.role: minimum cosine ratio to avoid blow-up

init_recovers: AUTO-S baseline when LR-ratio is constant
diff_from_baseline: Vs automatic_clipping (AUTO-S) and noise_decay: keeps AUTO-S per-sample normalization (sensitivity 1) but instead of step-decay schedules the noise as 1/sqrt(cosine LR), with sigma_0 chosen so the harmonic mean of per-step noises equals the calibrated budget sigma; uses a smaller γ=0.01 vs AUTO-S baseline's 1.0.

name: Layer-wise Adaptive Clip + Noise Decay
tagline: Per-layer Andrew-style quantile-adaptive clip thresholds combined with the noise_decay step-decay schedule on σ and global clip.
init_recovers: Adaptive clipping at noise_decay_factor=1; noise_decay at quantile rule disabled
diff_from_baseline: Vs adaptive_clipping + noise_decay: maintains a separate Andrew-style EMA threshold for EACH layer (rather than one global threshold), and modulates each per-layer threshold by the noise_decay step-decay schedule; noise per layer is calibrated to its own effective clip rather than a global one.

name: AUTO-S + Step-Decay Noise (AUTO-S-ND)
tagline: AUTO-S per-sample normalization with the noise_decay-style step-decay σ schedule, calibrated so harmonic-mean σ equals the budget σ.
diff_from_baseline: Vs automatic_clipping (AUTO-S) and noise_decay: composes AUTO-S sensitivity-1 normalization with the noise_decay step-decay σ schedule (no clipping decay since AUTO-S has no threshold), using harmonic-mean calibration of σ_0 to keep the privacy budget exact.

name: Anchor-Centered Residual Clipping + Late-Budget σ
tagline: Subtracts an EMA anchor of past noisy gradients before clipping residuals, with a cosine importance noise schedule that gives later steps lower σ.

key_hyperparams.name: center_scale
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of anchor used as recentering vector

init_recovers: Standard DP-SGD when anchor=0 and σ_t,C_t constant
diff_from_baseline: Vs standard_dpsgd / noise_decay: clips per-sample RESIDUALS around an EMA anchor of previously released (already-noisy) gradients (anchor is post-DP, hence public), then adds the anchor back; noise σ follows a cosine-importance schedule that allocates less noise to later steps and clip C decays in a (1-t/T)^{1/2} curve; harmonic-mean calibration keeps total privacy exact.
